content.text: A form whose fields show their validation errors. `onSubmit` receives the `FormData` of the named fields instead of the browser submitting the form. It can return errors keyed by field name, also from a promise, which show on those fields until they are edited.

Native constraints are checked when the form is submitted: `required`, and `pattern`, `minLength` and `maxLength` on a TextField. `validationErrors` shows errors you already have, for example from a server, keyed by field name like the ones `onSubmit` returns. An `error` set on a field itself takes precedence.

The form controls of `alinea/components` take a `name` to be submitted under: text, number and select controls submit their value as a string, dates and times as ISO strings (`2026-09-23`, `14:30`) and MultipleSelect one entry per picked value. To submit a form from a dialog, pass `onSubmit` to
: the dialog closes once it succeeds.
